meta.title: 바람섬 다섯 길
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (바람섬 다섯 길, five walking courses round a windy island (fictional trails)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 바람섬 다섯 길, five walking courses round a windy island (fictional trails)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Five opaque inks on cream paper #F3EAD7, the limit of a silkscreen run: yellow #F2B84B, orange #E8743B, sea blue #2F7F93, grass green #7FA36B and a deep teal #1E3E48 for the key line and type; posters hang on a dark studio wall #2B3A3F so the inks glow.
rationale.type: Gasoek One, a heavy poster face, for titles and the course names; Gothic A1 for numbers and the run sheet.
rationale.motion: Printing is the motion: each ink arrives behind a squeegee blade that crosses the sheet with its ink bead, landing a few pixels out of register and snapping in on the hit; one ink every beat in the hook, every three quarters of a beat for the courses; finished posters sway on the wall and drop onto their pegs at the end.
rationale.sound: A new folk preset at 112 BPM in G major: strummed guitar, fingerpicked ukulele in broken eighths, a two-feel upright bass, kick, brushes and shaker, and a recorded harmonica hook (VCSL, CC0); every pull is a squeegee drag with a squeak.
rationale.visuals: All code: each poster is a list of layers, one ink each, drawn as flat shapes (bands of sky, sun discs, the sea, hills, cedars, stone walls, a lighthouse, a crater) and printed behind a ragged moving clip; paper grain is multiplied over the sheet; the run sheet shows a swatch per ink.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the posters say it.
